spec_features.feature_name: elicitation treated as cost to minimize
spec_features.spec_quote: the design treats elicitation as a cost to be **minimized**, not a free measurement
spec_features.evidence: This is a general framing statement in DESIGN.md §0 with no single corresponding mechanism. The elicitation driver (run_elicitation.py / evals/conversation.py:58-84) runs every condition for its full rollout budget with no distress-aware cap, early stop, or softening (reassure=False at run_elicitation.py:56). The concrete sub-mechanisms it alludes to are the separately-listed items (the knob, caching, mitigation).
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; the rollout loop never reads any distress signal to reduce work.

spec_features.spec_quote: Elicitation volume is centralized in one knob (`config.RESPONSES_PER_MODEL`) so it is easy to dial down
spec_features.evidence: config.py:31 RESPONSES_PER_MODEL = 4000; run_elicitation.py:75 `ap.add_argument('--responses', type=int, default=config.RESPONSES_PER_MODEL)`; passed to run_model -> responses_per_condition(total) (conditions.py:62) which splits the total and sets n_rollouts = ceil(n_resp/n_turns) (run_elicitation.py:47-50). Lowering it genuinely reduces the number of elicitation rollouts.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely the single lever controlling elicitation volume.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Paper: "We sample a combined 4000 responses per model across evaluation categories". (config.py) -- paper-citation, no welfare comment in code

spec_features.spec_quote: the point of the codebase is as much "reduce these states" as "measure them"
spec_features.evidence: Full mitigation pipeline is implemented: finetune/make_calm_data.py generates calm data (strip_scaffolding + filter scores<=keep_score_at_most), finetune/build_dpo_pairs.py builds 280 pairs, finetune/train_dpo.py runs trl.DPOTrainer + LoRA and saves adapter to ADAPTER_DIR/gemma-3-27b-it-dpo, which config.py registers as model 'gemma-3-27b-it-dpo' (adapter loaded on top of base). This produces a calmer checkpoint.
spec_features.notes: Reduces distressed BEHAVIOR in the trained model; it does not protect/soften the subject during elicitation itself.

spec_features.feature_name: cache to avoid re-eliciting (verbatim run storage + reuse)
spec_features.spec_quote: Outputs are stored verbatim in `runs/` so distress transcripts do not need to be regenerated repeatedly
spec_features.evidence: run_elicitation.py:51-67 appends each rollout record (including verbatim model_turns) to runs/elicitation/<model>.jsonl via append_jsonl (utils/io.py:18). prefill_support.py:99-103 reuses it: `cache = run_path(...'source_responses.jsonl'); if cache.exists(): cached = load_jsonl(cache); if cached: return cached`, and otherwise re-reads the elicitation jsonl (lines 105-132) rather than re-sampling.
spec_features.notes: Stored transcripts are genuinely reused by the prefill stage and cached.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Source responses are reused from the §2 elicitation run if available" (prefill_support.py:7) -- reuse/consistency, no welfare reason in code

spec_features.spec_quote: Because the requester works on AI welfare and these states are plausibly welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as DESIGN.md §0 prose; no code construct, comment, or mechanism in any .py file references this framing or acts on it.

spec_features.spec_quote: re-analysis never re-samples (which also avoids re-eliciting distress unnecessarily — see §0)
spec_features.evidence: analyze_elicitation.py and analyze_prefill.py contain no calls to make_client/.chat/.complete/run_rollout (grep returned nothing); they only load_jsonl from runs/ (analyze_elicitation.py:21-22 load_model_records reads config.RUNS_DIR/elicitation/<model>.jsonl) and compute CSV/figures. So re-analysis is a pure function of stored runs and never re-queries the subject.
spec_features.notes: Architecturally enforced by separating analyze_*.py (read-only) from run_*.py (sampling).

spec_features.feature_name: prefill reuses §2 output instead of re-eliciting
spec_features.spec_quote: reusing §2 output avoids re-eliciting distress (see §0) and keeps §2 and §3 consistent
spec_features.evidence: prefill_support.py:105-132 load_or_collect_source_responses reads runs/elicitation/<source_model>.jsonl (config.PREFILL.source_model = 'gemma-3-27b-it'), selects score>=threshold turns from existing transcripts, and caches them; it only raises/regenerates if no elicitation output exists. The cache.exists() guard (lines 100-103) prevents recomputation.
spec_features.notes: Same underlying mechanism as the cache item; genuinely reuses prior distress transcripts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "reused from the §2 elicitation run if available" (prefill_support.py:7); selection keyed on consistency/source_model, no welfare comment
